skill.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skill.description: Guides safe completion of a development branch after implementation and tests, with structured choices for merge, pull request, preservation, or discard.
skill.summary: Finish a development branch with verified tests, clear Git options, and safe cleanup steps.
skill.author: Cycleaddict

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged Markdown code fences and shell examples used to document a Git completion workflow. I found no prompt injection, credential access, network exfiltration, or hidden execution intent in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Shell examples use placeholders that an agent must substitute correctly.
remediation.suggestion: Keep generated branch names, PR titles, and paths quoted, and prefer fixed-string matching for branch-name checks.

remediation.issue: The discard path includes destructive Git cleanup after user confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Continue requiring exact typed confirmation and show branch, commits, and worktree path before deletion.

content.value_statement: Finishing a branch requires safe choices after tests pass. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through merge, PR, keep, or discard workflows.
actual_capabilities: Verifies tests before presenting branch completion options.
Finds a likely base branch with git merge-base or asks for confirmation.
Presents four clear paths: merge locally, create a PR, keep the branch, or discard work.
Guides local merge, push, PR creation, and cleanup commands.
Requires typed confirmation before discarding branch work.
Handles worktree cleanup differently for merge, PR, keep, and discard choices.
limitations: Requires a working Git repository and a known project test command.
Depends on the GitHub CLI for pull request creation.
Does not decide team policy for merging or reviewing changes.
Does not proceed when tests fail or discard work without confirmation.

use_cases.title: Complete a Feature Branch
use_cases.description: Verify tests, choose a completion path, and clean up branch state after implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Push a finished branch and create a PR with a concise summary and test plan.

use_cases.title: Close Worktree-Based Tasks
use_cases.description: Finish a temporary worktree branch while preserving or removing the worktree as selected.

prompt_templates.title: Finish Current Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to finish my current development branch. Verify tests, then present the four completion options.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to verify my branch and guide me through pushing it and creating a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Locally
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to finish the branch with a local merge. Confirm tests pass before and after the merge.

prompt_templates.title: Finish Worktree Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill after a multi-worktree implementation. Identify the base branch, verify tests, present options, and apply my selected cleanup path.

output_examples.input: Implementation is complete and tests should pass.
output_examples.output: Tests passed. Implementation complete. Options are merge locally, create a pull request, keep the branch, or discard work.

output_examples.input: I want to discard this branch.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists the branch, commits, and worktree path, then waits for the exact discard confirmation.

output_examples.input: Create a PR for the finished work.
output_examples.output: The assistant pushes the current branch, opens a PR with summary and test plan, then preserves the worktree.

best_practices: Run the relevant test suite before choosing any completion path.
Confirm the base branch before merging or deleting feature work.
Use typed confirmation before any discard or branch deletion step.
anti_patterns: Do not offer merge or PR options while tests are failing.
Do not delete a branch or worktree without exact user confirmation.
Do not clean up a worktree when the selected path keeps it available.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it after implementation is complete and you need a structured branch completion decision.

faq.question: Can it create a pull request?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides pushing the branch and creating a PR when the GitHub CLI is available.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It prompts the assistant to run the project test suite before presenting completion options.

faq.question: Can it discard work?
faq.answer: Yes, but only after showing what will be deleted and receiving exact typed confirmation.

faq.question: Does it remove worktrees?
faq.answer: It removes worktrees for merge or discard paths and preserves them for keep-as-is.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
